title: Flanged belt pulley with narrow groove section and central bore
prompt: Make a flanged belt pulley as a single solid. The pulley has three coaxial sections stacked along Z, all centered on the Z axis, with the base on the XY plane. Bottom flange: a cylinder of diameter 80mm and height 8mm (z = 0 to z = 8). Belt groove section: a cylinder of diameter 50mm and height 24mm (z = 8 to z = 32). Top flange: a cylinder of diameter 80mm and height 8mm (z = 32 to z = 40). A central through-bore of diameter 16mm runs along the Z axis through the full height (z = 0 to z = 40). The three outer sections form the stepped outer profile of the pulley when unioned together; the belt rides in the groove between the two flanges. Output a single solid.
